assumptions.claim: The op_i input is driven to a legal encoding of the ciph_op_e enum (e.g., CIPH_ENC or CIPH_DEC) by external logic.
assumptions.cond: When the S-box is used for normal AES operation.
assumptions.risk: An illegal op_i may cause data_o to be incorrect, breaking the round transformation and potentially compromising cryptographic correctness.

uncertain_points.claim: The combinational logic that produces data_o from op_i and data_i is not included in this chunk; it must be verified in subsequent chunks.
uncertain_points.cond: Always true for this module interface.
uncertain_points.risk: Without the missing logic, the S-box behavior cannot be assessed, and any claims about correctness depend on other chunks.

uncertain_points.claim: The downstream logic that uses op_i may not handle all legal enum values; the extent of case coverage is unknown.
uncertain_points.cond: If op_i takes an unsupported encoding.
